tasks.title: Register additional references and trace each task operation

acceptance_criteria.22.1: WHEN a task context menu opens by mouse, row overflow or keyboard, THEN it SHALL target that row’s canonical ThreadId, preserve the active conversation, anchor to the initiating row/control, support focus movement, Escape/outside dismissal and focus restoration, and resolve availability, permissions and shortcuts from current canonical state and platform bindings.
acceptance_criteria.22.2: WHEN Pin or Unpin is chosen, THEN the existing persisted navigation owner SHALL update that task’s pinned state and all affected rows without changing project associations or activating the task.
acceptance_criteria.22.3: WHEN Share is chosen, THEN the canonical supported transcript sharing path SHALL share the targeted task with visible progress, errors and recovery; unsupported providers or missing authorization SHALL be explicitly unavailable without simulated success.
acceptance_criteria.22.4: WHEN Rename or Regenerate title is chosen, THEN the canonical thread metadata and summary provider SHALL update the targeted title, preserve explicit user overrides according to the native policy, and expose pending, unavailable and failed states.
acceptance_criteria.22.5: WHEN Mark as unread is chosen, THEN the canonical persisted task read-state owner SHALL update that task’s unread indication, independently of active conversation selection, and later reading SHALL clear it through the same owner.
acceptance_criteria.22.6: WHEN View details is chosen, THEN the interface SHALL display the targeted task’s actual identity, provider, timestamps, execution context and project associations from canonical owners.
acceptance_criteria.22.7: WHEN Copy content or Copy JSON is chosen, THEN the canonical transcript owner SHALL export the targeted content or structured transcript, including actual attribution and reply relationships, to the clipboard; metadata-only or fabricated content SHALL NOT count as a transcript export.
acceptance_criteria.22.8: WHEN project associations are viewed, added or removed, THEN the canonical association owner SHALL persist and update project/task navigation relationships without rewriting execution worktree paths or forking Project, Git, transcript or session ownership.
acceptance_criteria.22.9: WHEN Archive or Delete is chosen, THEN the interface SHALL perform distinct canonical operations: archive retains resumable history and restoration; delete follows provider-supported transcript deletion and native confirmation/error policy; neither operation SHALL be represented by merely removing a project association.
acceptance_criteria.22.10: THE additional references in screenshots/README.md SHALL be preserved unchanged and evaluated using populated production render paths with the menu closed, open and opened on a non-active task, with effective theme, fonts, unstable.ui_density, logical/physical dimensions and zoom recorded; missing host-window or authenticated-service evidence SHALL remain explicitly unverified.
